name: Raghav Awasthi

bullets: Shipped Votal, NVIDIA Nemotron and dual-model guard routing across a 24-file feature branch by extending vLLM serving and synchronous/asynchronous fan-out with concurrent verdict aggregation.
Preserved backward compatibility across 1,066 offline tests by adding 47 routing and launcher tests plus two live contract cases covering payload construction, response parsing and failure handling.

Hardened the AI gateway against five weakness classes by fixing hCaptcha verification, backend URL handling, subprocess model paths, tenant regexes and LLM tool-call validation for CWE-288, CWE-918, CWE-78, ReDoS and prompt injection.

Used AI coding tools to accelerate design, implementation, regression-test generation and documentation while manually validating NVIDIA NIM/vLLM contracts and reviewing generated changes before commit.
Projected a 20-30% shorter PQC transition across 30+ services by producing a 60-page PQC/HSM security assessment, capability and gap matrix, and five-phase implementation roadmap.

Cut certificate triage time 25% and flagged 30+ high-risk certificates by building Python services for CA-chain enrichment, root-cause classification, ServiceNow normalisation, risk scoring and OpenSSL path-frequency analysis over million-row extracts.

Developed 15+ KQL/SPL threat-hunting queries against live Microsoft Defender, Sentinel and Splunk logs, promoting 7+ detections to production and increasing high-signal alerts approximately 20% in pilot; expanded a signal with 100+ threat terms.
Personally triaged and investigated 210+ incidents by correlating live security telemetry to distinguish actionable threats from benign activity.

Completed Copilot prompt-injection testing and presented a GenAI threat assessment to Cyber Operations covering prompt injection, data exfiltration, model poisoning, insecure code generation and mitigations.
Kept median query latency below 3 seconds across 140M+ rows and 150+ filter combinations by indexing PostgreSQL and PostGIS queries behind 30+ versioned FastAPI endpoints.
Enabled rollback in under 10 minutes by containerising and automating CI/CD for a production FastAPI, PostgreSQL and Next.js application delivered through the complete SDLC.
Raised domain F1 15%, cut mean GPU latency 20% and reduced peak VRAM 60% by leading five engineers to 4-bit LoRA/PEFT fine-tune a 7B model on 120k curated records and benchmark 6k questions.

Improved retrieval MRR 25% and cut hallucination rate to 7% by converting 295 multilingual PDFs (4k pages) into 12k chunks and 24k QA pairs with Selenium, PyMuPDF/Tesseract, translation, BM25 and MiniLM; limited manual correction to 10%.

Demonstrated 20 authenticated Flask/Gradio endpoints to stakeholders, achieving 13% English WER, 20% Indonesian WER, 11% Thai CER and approximately 2-second short-request latency across Thai LLM, Whisper/Wav2Vec2 ASR and VITS TTS workflows; kept checkpoint A/B tests under five minutes.

Completed 100 hybrid TLS 1.3 handshakes at approximately 20 ms overhead by implementing ML-KEM/Kyber512 NTT arithmetic, key generation, encapsulation and decapsulation in Python; validated 800-byte public keys, 768-byte ciphertexts and 32-byte shared secrets while comparing NIST PQC finalists.

Executed 100-qubit transverse-field Ising circuits on IBM Brisbane with up to 10 Trotter configurations, 12 parameter values and approximately 4,096 shots per circuit by using Qiskit Runtime, SamplerV2/EstimatorV2 and XY4 dynamical decoupling.
Coordinated four teammates across three to four workstreams, reviewed approximately 12 changes, ran six to eight progress reviews and presented the completed work to approximately 10 stakeholders.
